task.question_description: For full credit, the only permitted departures from the trusted correct True-or-False reference are capitalization and whitespace at the beginning or end of the response. Extra words are not permitted, and the opposite label does not qualify. Responses satisfying this whole-response match, after trimming and lowercasing, receive full credit.

analysis_profile.note: These are fixed analysis bindings, native input/reference assumptions, normalization and threshold, supplied by the experiment. They are not inferred from the question. They do not specify which semantic obligations to select.
